description: lib/note-set-eyecatch.py and lib/note-set-single-price.py -- both authored in this same sprint -- duplicate ~20 lines of near-identical logic verbatim: the cookie-file existence check + JSON load + cookie-dict-to-list conversion (compare note-set-eyecatch.py lines 44-52 to note-set-single-price.py lines 49-54), and the cloakbrowser session bootstrap + navigate + 'wait up to 20s for 公開に進む to appear in body innerText' polling loop (compare note-set-eyecatch.py lines 54-68 to note-set-single-price.py lines 56-70) -- differing only in one viewport-height constant and one log string. Neither file factors this into a shared helper module (e.g. a lib/note_browser_common.py), despite both files living in the same lib/ directory and being written together for the same PROP-21 fix.
